summary: Measure EVE, NII and repricing exposure with applied IRRBB exercises. Review the course outline and see how it fits your banking team.
lede: Banking-book interest rate risk analysis helps treasury, ALM, risk and finance professionals assess how rate changes affect earnings and economic value. The training supports practical balance-sheet decisions through repricing cash-flow analysis, EVE and NII scenario assessment, and review of behavioural assumptions and limit controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for banking professionals who measure, challenge, govern or report interest-rate exposure in the banking book.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with bank balance-sheet products, treasury or risk reporting, and basic Excel is recommended. No programming is required. Advanced behavioural modelling is addressed at operational review level, not implementation level.
